spectatorMemory.launcherDefaultsVerified: formal02 strips all inherited MIR2_ variables and sets only a dedicated spectator data directory, retaining enabled/recording/public defaults.
spectatorMemory.exactScope: Frame count is bounded per map. The2MiB guard is encoded world+events payload, not a bound on serde_json Value/BTree/string heap, outer metadata, temporary clone peaks, allocator retained pages or process RSS/private bytes.
spectatorMemory.possibleWarmupExplanation: The parent observed private bytes rising during06 before a ten-minute ring could fill. That is consistent with filling retained frame history but does not establish the cause, a leak, a stable plateau or memory acceptance.
positiveBounds: Ring pops the oldest frame whenever length exceeds configured2400.
Pending events are trimmed to2048 and each accepted frame contains at most512 events.
Current merged entity/drop IDs and last-seen tables are pruned by15s staleness on subsequent publishes.
AttackV2 connection keeps one completed result Option; it does not append one result per attack.
Zone request telemetry uses fixed bucket arrays and cumulative counters, not an ever-growing sample history.
remainingProductionBudgetIssues: maps BTreeMap has no map eviction. The map0-only formal profile bounds this test to one map; general multi-map operation has no audited global map budget here.

max_entities2048 is applied per input snapshot; the latest-world merge unions IDs across sources and is not globally capped at2048. Ground-drop arrays and map decoration are not capped by that entity setting.
The frame-size guard is after merge/clone/encoding. It prevents accepting an oversized ring frame, but it does not bound latest-world or temporary allocation before rejection.
Replay returns at most10000 frames per request but a byte/concurrency heap budget was not audited; the player-only capacity profile does not request replay.
Recording disk cleanup runs at hub initialization only. During a long running process there is no rolling byte quota or periodic prune in this code;64KiB only bounds one buffered write operation.
unchangedProfileMonitoring: Keep original300s stage100, then original300s memory warmup and32MiB/hour gate.

Do not infer complete replacement solely from600s wall time: capture interval is a maximum4Hz. Record bufferedFrames=2400 and publishedFramesTotal delta>=2400 since final cohort/density expansion; skipped or delayed captures can take longer.

Correlate private/working-set slope with activeMaps, bufferedFrames, published/persisted/dropped/recordingErrors counters and observed frame/recording bytes; report RSS/allocator limitations explicitly.
Use the actual declared resource and disk guards. If growth or failure remains, preserve it; lower-N follow-up requires a separate prospective profile.
